name: <spec name, matches folder>

spec.name: <spec name>
spec.version: <integer, the frozen spec version this map satisfies>

fixture.text: <what it represents; changing it invalidates every baseline and is a map revision>

locked_paths: <test directories, check scripts, the fixture, and this file; read-only to implementing agents during a run, enforced by hook>
run_all: <optional; one command for a human sanity pass; machine consumers use per-check commands>

checks.name: <optional short human label, no meaning; cross-reference by id only>
checks.kind: <acceptance | unit | contract | golden | schema | budget | constraint | boundary | structural>
covers: <spec node ids: B<n>, E<n>, C<n>, I<n>, or 'scope'>
checks.command: <exact command; exit code is the verdict>
checks.note: <reason, only when status not ok, or a caveat the reader needs>

unverified.ref: <spec node id with no mapped check>
unverified.reason: <why it cannot or will not be checked>

baseline.commit: <code commit the full baseline ran at>
baseline.result: <one line: every check's observed matches its expect, or which do not>

covers: <spec node ids it covered; each must be remapped or in unverified in the same version>
